pool.text: King John announced the foundation of the borough of Liverpool in letters patent.
The parish church of Liverpool near the waterfront existed since this year.
An Act of Parliament made Liverpool a parish the same year.
The first commercial wet dock was built in Liverpool.
The world's first enclosed wet dock known as the Old Dock was constructed.
The oldest building in the area is Liverpool Town Hall, dating from this year.
Liverpool opened and operated the site of Britain's first provincial airport.
Liverpool's population reached an all-time high at the United Kingdom census.
Frank Hornby produced the popular toy line known as Dinky Toys.
Liverpool began its official partnership by being twinned with Cologne.
An anthology of poems called The Mersey Sound has sold well since publication.
The city was moved from Lancashire to the county of Merseyside.
The La's released their hit single There She Goes in this year.
Liverpool Airport was renamed in honour of the musician John Lennon.
Several areas across the city were declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
The city held the title of European Capital of Culture to celebrate heritage.
The arena opened and hosted the MTV Europe Music Awards the same year.
Leeds and Liverpool Canal runs into the city centre via Pier Head.
The Wheel of Liverpool opened on the twenty-fifth day of March.
Port workers at Liverpool held a series of strikes over their pay.
